parole.significato: The courtyard of a Maori wharenui or meeting-house, seen as a cultural and spiritual focal point.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Māori marae and Tahitian marae, from Proto-Oceanic *malaqe.

parole.significato: In Māori and Polynesian culture, restriction of access to a place, as a form of taboo.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Māori rāhui or Tahitian rāhui.

parole.significato: Any of various New Zealand plants of the genus Metrosideros.
parole.testo: ] From Māori rātā or cognate Tahitian rātā (“tree of genus Metrosideros”). Compare Tahitian puarātā (“Metrosideros collina”).
